associations.rationale: The displayed type only declares a representation type from a ring and an additive group; it does not itself state the algebra-homomorphism or left-module characterization.
The formal type provides only the construction from an algebra homomorphism to a module structure; by itself it does not state the claimed equivalence.
The formal type states only one round-trip identity used to prove the characterization, not the full equivalence asserted by the source claim.
The formal type provides only the construction from a module structure to an algebra homomorphism; by itself it does not state the claimed equivalence.
The formal type states only the converse round-trip identity used to prove the characterization, not the full equivalence asserted by the source claim.
